method: Exact continuous axis-aligned rectangular sweep along X, against CAD/model plan AABBs; no sample skipping
limitations: Single shared line only. Concurrent opposing cart moves are not checked and must remain mutually exclusive.
No camera-frustum or occlusion evidence is available in these plan coordinates; greater distance does not prove the exchange leaves the fixed view.
Static obstacles use source CAD and current operations asset AABBs, not live navigation or surveyed safe operational clearances.
